events.title: Justin Caguiat: Change Ringing
events.description: Discover Justin Caguiat in his first UK institutional exhibition. Explore painting, sculpture, printmaking, sound and film in a site-responsive installation.

events.title: Amar Kanwar
events.description: Slow down, look carefully and reflect. Visit Amar Kanwar's film exhibition at Serpentine North, bringing together new and existing works.

events.title: Saturday Talks: Natalia Grabowska on Justin Caguiat: Change Ringing
events.description: Natalia Grabowska, Curator at Large, Architecture and Site-Specific Projects, leads a tour of Justin Caguiat: Change Ringing.

events.title: Saturday Talks: Kit Gurnos on Amar Kanwar
events.description: Kit Gurnos, Assistant Exhibitions Curator, gives an introduction to New Delhi-based artist and filmmaker Amar Kanwar.

events.title: Pierre Alechinsky
events.description: In celebration of a radical and experimental artist, explore Pierre Alechinsky’s graphically rich and exuberant body of paintings and works on paper.

events.title: Matt Copson
events.description: Step into Matt Copson’s first major solo exhibition in the UK at Serpentine North. Discover Copson’s celebrated work, spanning laser animation, sculpture, animatronics and sound.

events.title: Adrian Piper, I'm This Space: Selected Works 1967 - 2027
events.description: Experience Adrian Piper’s use of irony, humour and audience participation to challenge beliefs about the construction of race, gender and truth.

events.title: Serpentine x The Flag Foundation Prize: Gozo Yoshimasu
events.description: Celebrate Gozo Yoshimasu, the inaugural recipient of The FLAG Art Foundation Prize and one of Japan’s most radical and celebrated poets.

events.title: Lisa Brice
events.description: Discover Lisa Brice’s new exhibition at Serpentine, bringing together new and existing paintings that challenge traditional representations of women in art history.
